finalText:
**Real bug is in `refresh.js`, not `tokens.js`.**

`auth.internal` returned `400 invalid_grant` (revoked refresh token). That code isn't in `RECOVERABLE`, so [refresh.js:15](src/auth/refresh.js:15) returns `undefined` instead of throwing.

`session.js` then hands that `undefined` straight to `decode()`, which crashes trying to `.split('.')` on it. `tokens.js:6` is just where the `undefined` finally blows up, not where it came from.

Look at [refresh.js:14-16](src/auth/refresh.js:14): the non-recoverable path needs to throw (so the caller can 401 and force re-login), not silently return `undefined`.
